Subject: Request: hosted API baseline pricing + NDA

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Acme is evaluating hosted API options for our new Assist product and Procurement asked me to gather baseline pricing (rate card) for hosted token generation and embeddings, plus the process for signing your NDA.

Can you share: 
- A baseline rate card PDF showing list prices and any standard volume bands
- A copy of Redwood's standard mutual NDA (we can share comments after review)
- Any notes on typical discounting for early stage pilots or committed monthly spend

We're aiming to start a 3-month pilot in September. If you need an initial estimate for expected usage to suggest a discount band, we can share a rough monthly token estimate (likely 50M tokens/month to start).

Please let me know the next steps and whether you need a PO or signed NDA first.

Best,
Emma

Acme Corp

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the usage estimate, that helps a lot.

Attaching Redwood's standard mutual NDA (NDA_template_redwood_20260812.pdf) and our initial public-facing rate card (redwood_ratecard_v1.pdf). A few quick notes:

- Rate card is list price for hosted API (generation + embeddings). It includes an examples section for $/1K tokens, embeddings per-1K, and standard volume bands.
- For pilots, we typically offer a pilot discount or a short-term promotional band depending on committed monthly spend. For ~50M tokens/month, our AE team would usually qualify you for a mid-tier pilot discount — final terms depend on contract length and support requirements.
- We require a signed NDA before sharing any customer-specific commercial playbooks or discounted rate sheets; the template attached should be fine to sign in DocuSign or return signed PDF.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Emma signs the NDA and returns (or sends via DocuSign).
2) Aditya (cc'd) will propose a pilot pricing sketch based on the 50M tokens/month — he can include suggested commitment tiers and an optional trial credit.
3) Marissa (cc'd, commercial/legal) will note any redlines to the NDA.

Thanks — I can also set up a quick call this week to walk through the rate card details.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Hi Emma — thanks for sharing the 50M tokens/month number. Quick sketch from us: 

- List price: see attached redwood_ratecard_v1.pdf (Grace attached).
- Pilot band (30–70M tokens/mo): typically a 15% list discount for a 3-month pilot with a small support package included.
- Committed monthly pricing (6–12 month commit) can go to 20–30% depending on total spend and support/SLA level.

If Acme expects 50M/mo as a steady state, I can draft a pilot quote with two options: (A) 3-month pilot @ 15% off list + $X in trial credits; (B) 6-month commit @ 20% off list. Which would you prefer I prepare?

Also looping in Marissa for quick NDA guidance — Marissa, the client may want DocuSign. Are there any standard redlines we should expect?

Thanks,
Aditya
